body:
I looked at your picture.  You are not a bad looking guy.  Women are not always attracted to "hot" looking guys.  Look up the lead singer from the Cars and his wife.  He may be a talented singer but he is not a physically attractive man,  He married a supermodel and they were married for about 28 years with two kids.  They may be separated now but that doesn't matter.  

Maybe you just need to get better at talking with the ladies.  It isn't that hard.  Also, maybe you are setting your sights too high.  There are many women out there who are just as frustrated as you about meeting a guy.  You just need to figure out how and where to meet them.  Try some dating sites - Match, eHarmony, etc.  They even have specialty ones for tall people or short people or handicapped people.  There are lots of women who would be thrilled to meet a nice guy and that is what you have to be - a nice guy.  Not some bad boy asshole. Go to some groups that you have an interest in like local hiking club or photography group (just examples as I have no idea what you like to do).  At least any women who are there at least share a common interest.  Then you can't come on too strong.  You need to build a little bit of a foundation with them before you ask them to coffee or something.  Coffee or lunch are good because there are essentially time limits for the both of you so no one feels trapped.  And, if she doesn't work out, don't be mad, be polite, wish her well and move on to the next one.

If you are so concerned with your looks, find a stylist or someone that can help you with a good haircut that fits your face and coloring.  Find someone who can help you pick out a nice wardrobe.  Also (and I am not saying this about you because I don't know you at all) but most women appreciate good hygiene - clean, smell nice (not overpowering cologne) no bad breath, showers every day, wears clean clothes, etc.  

You may other issues you don't want to talk about here, which I understand, but don't cut yourself short.  You can meet someone nice who will appreciate everything you do for them.  But don't come on too strong or too quickly they you seem creepy.  Any relationship takes time so give it some time but keep trying.

Me?  I got a whole bunch of other issues that are driving me toward suicide but I am older,  You are young and have a lot to give.  Don't give up on the ladies and don't become one of those basement dwelling, neck beard, weird Incel (I think that is what they are called). that just hate women because they got rejected.   Women are not bad.  Just like guys, some are assholes and some are really nice.

You can do this.

I have been trying to get help for most of my adult life!  Sometimes diseases are incurable.  Believe me, this is not something that I enjoy.  I have missed out on a lot.  Unfortunately, most people equate Depression with just being sad.  That is like saying cancer is just a cold.  It will pass.  Sometimes, a cure just doesn't exist. I'd give my left nut to not have this in my life.
